high_level_description: This image depicts an outdoor scene featuring a terracotta statue of Ganesha, the Hindu deity of wisdom and remover of obstacles. The statue is intricately carved with detailed patterns on its body and head, which is adorned with a crown-like structure. It is seated in a meditative pose, with one hand resting on its knee and the other raised in a gesture of blessing. The statue is placed inside a large, ornate terracotta pot that has a wide mouth and a narrow base.
